prompt:
Create a review page template for a business loan affiliate program. The page should evaluate a funding affiliate program based on commission structure, product types, partner support, training, tracking, payout model, best-fit affiliates, pros, cons, and alternatives.
Visual style: editorial fintech review page with comparison tables, scorecards, pros and cons boxes, dark header, clean article layout, and sticky CTA.
Strong hook: “Is This Business Loan Affiliate Program Worth Promoting?”
Hero message: “A practical breakdown of commissions, products, partner support, tracking, payout potential, and who this program is actually built for.”
CTA: “View Program Details”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- Program scorecard
- Commission overview
- Products offered
- Best-fit affiliates
- Pros and cons
- Comparison table
- Who should avoid it
- CTA section
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static page files.
